# Lokalt

Lokalt is a free, independent tool that helps Helsinki residents figure out
which city body is responsible for a problem or idea, and drafts a message
they can send themselves. It is not an official service of the City of
Helsinki. There are no accounts and no user data is stored; Lokalt never
sends email on a user's behalf.

Residents describe their concern in their own words, in Finnish, Swedish, or
English. Lokalt classifies the concern and routes it: things that are broken
go to the city's existing fault-report channel, personal or legal matters go
to the right statutory channel, brand-new ideas go to citizen-participation
channels, and policy questions (where a city body should decide something
differently) get a real contact and a short draft email.

- Finnish: https://www.helppolokal.org/fi
- Swedish: https://www.helppolokal.org/sv
- English: https://www.helppolokal.org/en
- About: https://www.helppolokal.org/fi/om
